answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the spiral scores zero and the identity stops earning. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest dune a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. The pulse ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal g49q4.
